content: तन्त्रम् .²1 A loom; तदाऽपश्यत् स्त्रियौ तन्त्रे अधिरोप्य सुवेमे पटं वयन्त्यौ <ls>Mb. 1. 3. 144</ls>. .²2 A thread. .²3 The warp or threads extended lengthwise in a loom; सिरीस्तन्त्रं तन्वते अप्रजज्ञयः <ls>Rv. 10. 71. 9</ls>. .²4 Posterity. .²5 An uninterrupted series. .²6 The regular order of ceremonies and rites, system, framework, ritual; कर्मणां युगपद्भावस्तन्त्रम् <ls>Kāty.</ls>; अशक्यं हि उत्तरं तन्त्रं कर्तुम् . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 57</ls>. .²7 Main point; प्रकर्षतन्त्रा हि रणे जयश्रीः <ls>Ki. 3. 17</ls>. .²8 Principal doctrine, rule, theory, science; विधिनोपचरेद्देवं तन्त्रोक्तेन च केशवम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 3. 47</ls>; जितमनसिजतन्त्रविचारम् <ls>Gīt. 2</ls>. .²9 Subservience, dependence; as in स्वतन्त्र, परतन्त्र; दैवतन्त्रं दुःखम् <ls>Dk. 5</ls>. .²10 A scientific work. .²11 A chapter, section, as of a work; तन्त्रैः पञ्चभिरेतच्चकार सुमनोहरं शास्त्रम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²12 A religious treatise teaching magical and mystical formularies for the worship of the deities or the attainment of superhuman power; <ls>Ks. 23. 63</ls>; <ls>Bṛ. S. 16. 19</ls>. .²13 The cause of more than one effect. .²14 A spell. .²15 A chief remedy or charm; जानन्ति तन्त्रयुक्तिम् <ls>Ms. 2. 1</ls>. .²16 A drug, medicament. .²17 An oath, ordeal. .²18 Raiment. .²19 The right way of doing anything. .²20 Royal retinue, train, court. .²21 A realm, country, authority. .²22 .³({%a%}) Government, ruling, administration; लोकतन्त्रविधानम् <ls>Mb. 3. 162. 1</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">13. 63. 5</ls>; लोकतन्त्राधिकारः <ls>Ś. 5</ls>. .³({%b%}) Arrangement or machinery of government; सर्वमेव तन्त्रमाकुलीभूतम् <ls>Mu. 1</ls>, <ls n="Mu.">2. 1</ls>. .²23 An army; पराजिताः फल्गुतन्त्रैः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 54. 15</ls>. .²24 A heap, multitude. .²25 A house. .²26 Decoration. .²27 Wealth. .²28 Happiness. .²29 Model. .²30 Supporting a family; <ls>Mv. 2. 17</ls>. .²31 Providing for the security and prosperity of a kingdom; <ls>Mb. 1. 103. 26</ls>. .²32 A group of acts or subsidiaries common to several प्रधानकर्मs or things; यत् सकृत्कृतं बहूनामुपकरोति तत् तन्त्रमित्युच्यते . तथा बहूनां ब्राह्मणानां मध्ये कृतः प्रदीपः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 11. 1. 1</ls>; तन्त्रं साधारणो धर्मग्रामः . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 1</ls>. (<ab>Opp.</ab> आवापः) .²33 The order of the world; यतः प्रवर्तते तन्त्रं यत्र च प्रतितिष्ठति <ls>Mb. 14. 20. 14</ls>. .²34 A detail (matter or thing) which is subservient to ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} serves the purpose of) several things simultaneously; साधारणं भवेत् तन्त्रम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 1</ls>.
